commands: '--- any leftover staging / fetch dirs? (must be NONE) ---'

if($found.Count -eq 0){'  none - staging cleaned up correctly'}else{ $found | ForEach-Object { '  LEFTOVER: ' + $_.FullName + '  (' + [int](((Get-ChildItem $_.FullName -Recurse -File | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum)/1MB) + ' MB)' } }
'--- all dirs under the app dir, for context ---'
'--- disk headroom (a snapshot transiently doubles ~80 MB) ---'
Get-PSDrive C | ForEach-Object { '  C: used {0:N1} GB   free {1:N1} GB' -f ($_.Used/1GB),($_.Free/1GB) }
